messages:
Marta (mktg): Heads-up: coordinate embargoed launch assets + demo routing for Optimize v2 next Tue. Need changelog copy, final docs link, embargo time, and where inbound demo leads should land. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/501 . Docs preview: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2-embargo .

Diego (eng): Were good to start canary at 07:00 PT for internal verification only (no public traffic). Public canary at 09:00 PT with 3% traffic, staged to 100% by 13:00 PT. Will add a "demo-pin" variant so webinar and press demos hit a consistent backend.

Emily (docs): I uploaded an embargo-friendly docs snapshot (removed the hero benchmark figures under embargo). Final URL after embargo lift: https://redwood.docs/release/optimize-v2 . Can update immediately when marketing gives the OK.

Priya (prod-marketing): We're aligning press embargo until 12:00 PT. Social publish scheduled at embargo lift +5m. Need final benchmark copy (short) and confirmation of demo variant name for writeups. Also routing: demo leads to go to trial-onboarding@redwood.ai.

Samir (sales): Noted—please route demo leads to trial-onboarding and cc sales-trials. We want SDRs to get the enriched lead row within 30m. Also flag enterprise-tier customers so AE team can reach out.

Diego (eng): Demo variant = optimize-v2-demo-pin. I'll add an explicit routing rule. Also will tag enterprise-origin requests (customer_id present) so they go to sales-trials.

Marta (mktg): Changelog needs a short rollback section and the embargo blurb removed. I'll PR the press snippet once numbers are final.

Diego (eng): Rollback steps added to the changelog with commands and a one-click dashboard toggle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1620 .

Priya (prod-marketing): Benchmark hero (prelim): "~35% median latency reduction at 6k context and ~30% token cost savings vs previous defaults." Diego, confirm we can use that under embargo?

Diego (eng): Confirmed. It's allowed under embargo. Raw benchmark links included in the changelog for press tech review.

Emily (docs): I'll prepare a lightweight faq entry for press: "How to reproduce the benchmark" and a short note about model variants. Will push after embargo lift.

Marta (mktg): Embargo lift set to 12:00 PT next Tue. Can everyone freeze copy until 11:50 PT? We will replace preview links with live docs + changelog links at lift.

Samir (sales): SDRs will be on standby at 12:30 PT. Please ensure demo leads include region and company size fields.

Diego (eng): Adding metadata to demo leads: region, customer_tier, request_context. Also will ensure demo endpoint returns a header X-variant: optimize-v2-demo-pin for tracking.

deploy-bot: Internal canary scheduled by Diego at 2026-03-31T07:00:00-07:00. Public canary scheduled at 2026-03-31T09:00:00-07:00.

Priya (prod-marketing): We'll queue socials for 12:05 PT (embargo lift +5). Press release ready but holding until link swap.

Marta (mktg): Great. Post-lift checklist: swap docs links in press kit, push changelog final notes, update demo endpoint in webinar slides, confirm lead routing, and run a 30m postmortem on metrics.

Emily (docs): Redirects and canonical metadata ready. Will flip the preview path to live at 12:00 PT.

Diego (eng): Public canary health checks green in staging. Will monitor on-call alerts and keep rollback ready.

Marta (mktg): Thanks team. I'll send the embargoed press packet to the list and pin this thread for follow-ups. If anything changes, call out ASAP. :lock::rocket:
